Name: Ghost Pets for Alternative Textures
Author: ashleyketchumtr
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][img]https://imgur.com/5uN6YUG.png[/img]﻿
[size=4][img]https://imgur.com/yhGEUJb.png[/img]﻿

[/size][size=4]Bring a hauntingly delightful twist to your Stardew Valley farm with the [b]Ghost Pets[/b] mod![/size]
[/font][/center][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][center][font=Georgia][size=3]Ever wanted your farm pets to have a spectral presence? Now they can! The [b]Ghost Pets[/b] mod allows you to change the textures of your cats and dogs to eerie ghost versions. This mod includes two ghostly colors—purple and green—each with a glowing aura to give your pets an otherworldly appearance. As they move around the farm, watch them fade in and out, adding to the spooky ambiance of your farm.[/size][size=3][u][b]

Features[/b][/u][/size][size=3][b]
Two ghostly colors[/b]: Choose between purple and green for your cats, dogs & turtles.
[/size][size=3][b]Glowing & sparkling aura[/b]: Each ghost pet has a mystical glow and sparkle!
[/size][size=3][b]Fading effect[/b]: Pets fade in and out while moving to enhance the spooky effect.
[size=3][b]Inspired by [/b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/about-me][b]BogWyytch[/b][/url]﻿: This mod is inspired by and posted with the approval of Bog, to match with her Haunted Farm Animals![/size][/size][size=3][u][b]


[img]https://imgur.com/WIj4nRN.png[/img]﻿

[/b][/u]Ensure you have [b]Alternative Textures[/b] installed.
[font=Georgia]Download and extract into your Mods folder.[/font]
Purchase the [b]scissors [/b]from Robin to apply the new textures.[/size]
